text:
laura: Customer 'northwind-analytics' flagged ~2.5k embeds missing from their May invoice vs their client logs. They say counts are present in our daily export but not on invoice line items.

billing-bot: automated alert: reconcile-window-mismatch detected for northwind-analytics 2025-05-01 to 2025-05-02. Delta -2,512 embeds. Ticket FIN-7801 opened.

omar: quick ledger check: we have 38,712 embeds recorded for 2025-05-01 in UTC, but invoice tool aggregated by customer local date (Europe/Berlin) and our ingestion service stamped events in UTC. Because May 1 was the DST boundary in CET, a handful of events at 00:30 UTC were attributed to May 1 in UTC but to May 2 in CET invoice window. That explains the apparent undercount on the May invoice.
julia-finance: finance note: how many embeds are misattributed vs truly missing? If they exist in the ledger we shouldn't credit, we should correct the invoice grouping and send an invoice addendum or reconciled statement.
david: I ran a query: SELECT sum(embed_count) FROM ingest_ledger WHERE customer_id='northwind-analytics' AND ts BETWEEN '2025-05-01T00:00:00Z' AND '2025-05-02T00:00:00Z'; returns 41,200. Invoice grouped by Europe/Berlin local date produced 38,688 for May 1 local. Delta attributable to timezone shift = 2,512. No events are missing.
sara: recommend we avoid issuing a credit for ledger-present events. Instead: 1) send a corrected usage statement that explains the timezone boundary and shows the reconciliation; 2) update invoice memo to clarify billing window is UTC-derived; 3) add a short-term fix to invoice generation to align with customer timezone preferences or surface the timezone in invoices.
laura: customer-facing language: "we found your usage was recorded correctly in our system but was grouped on a different local date due to DST. We've attached a reconciliation CSV and an updated usage statement for May." OK?
julia-finance: approved. We'll attach FIN-7801 reconciliation CSV and create an invoice addendum note: "Usage grouping adjusted for timezone boundary; no charge change. See reconciliation attached."
omar: internal action: add a check in monthly billing pipeline to flag customers with >0.5% delta between UTC- and local-grouped usage before finalizing invoices. I'll file an infra ticket.
david: saving reconciliation CSV to s3://forensics/northwind/2025-05-dst-reconcile.csv and linking to FIN-7801.
laura: sending reconciled statement and explanatory note to account team; will CC support and close after confirmation from customer.
sara: adding runbook item and a small billing-systems JIRA: BILL-1423 to allow per-customer timezone preference when generating invoice grouping.
laura: customer acknowledged receipt and thanked us for the clear reconciliation. Closing finance loop.
laura: closing thread."
